module.name: aws_eks_cluster_install_tmm_nads
module.description: Host-device TMM data-plane prep (awsbnkctl phase16/17/17c/20): labels the single role=bnk TMM node, assigns SelfIP <subnet>.240 to each tagged secondary ENI, runs an iface-discovery probe (MAC->ifname->PCI) before any TMM pod exists, and applies host-device NADs (external-netdevice/internal-netdevice, pciBusID) in f5-cne-system + default. Surfaces ifname/PCI/SelfIP/AZ for cneinstall. Multus install is handled by eks-cluster-install-multus (depends on it via multus_ready). Runs between install-multus/bnk-prereqs and cneinstall.

required.reason: Provides vpc_id (parity wiring). The discovery script refreshes its own exec-auth kubeconfig via aws eks update-kubeconfig.
Multus must be installed and the NAD CRD Established before host-device NADs are applied. multus_ready gate auto-wires from this module's output.
Provides the single role=bnk TMM node + the tagged secondary ENIs (f5-bnk:tmm-role) this module discovers, assigns SelfIPs to, and binds host-device NADs onto.

optional.reason: Alternative upstream — emits the same vpc_id output.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Resolved by Forge's credential template at deploy time (any auth method).

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: EKS cluster name. Used to refresh an exec-auth kubeconfig (aws eks update-kubeconfig) and resolve the TMM node. Auto-wired from the blueprint eks_cluster_name input.

required.name: multus_ready
required.description: Gate from eks-cluster-install-multus. Asserted true before host-device NADs are applied.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token. Populated for STS / SSO / assumed-role; empty for static keys.

optional.name: vpc_id
optional.description: Cluster VPC ID (parity wiring). Auto-wired from cluster-register / cluster-create.

optional.name: nad_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where the NADs are created (plus `default`). MUST match the CNEInstance namespace. Gold-standard split: f5-cne-system.

optional.name: nad_external_name
optional.description: External host-device NAD name (→ TMM trunk 1.1). Must match cneinstall network_attachments[0].

optional.name: nad_internal_name
optional.description: Internal host-device NAD name (→ TMM trunk 1.2). Must match cneinstall network_attachments[1].

optional.name: selfip_host_offset
optional.description: Host octet for the TMM SelfIP within each /24 TMM subnet (awsbnkctl uses .240).

optional.name: skip_iface_discovery
optional.description: Skip the privileged iface-discovery pod and use the deterministic device-index PCI fallback (ens8=0000:00:08.0, ens7=0000:00:07.0).

key_outputs.name: nads_applied
key_outputs.description: Gate output — SelfIPs assigned + both host-device NADs applied.

key_outputs.name: tmm_az
key_outputs.description: AZ of the single TMM node.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS credential template (STS / SSO / assumed-role only).
